question: does the diffusion model capture structure an order-3 Markov chain cannot?
why_order3: an order-3 chain's sufficient statistic IS the 4-mer conditional distribution

eval.strain_note: corpus E. coli is GCA_059754755.1 (draft); eval is GCF_000005845.2 (MG1655), and eval genes have NO draft counterpart

why_primary: left_only matches the information budget (both see only the unmasked left prefix) and markov_ecoli is the STRONG 4-mer null, fit on the E. coli the model actually trained on. The pooled chain is reported because it is the same-data pairing, but it barely beats uniform and is the WEAK null.
verdict_detail: On this eval set the model scores 1.4098 nats and the strong null 1.4291, both against uniform 1.3863 -- so neither beats a random guess. The model-vs-null delta is therefore a comparison between sub-chance predictors and carries NO information about structure beyond 4-mers. REFUSING a verdict rather than reporting the delta. This is the accessory-gene out-of-distribution failure the staged plan predicted: filtering orthology by gene necessarily selects strain-specific (prophage / plasmid / HGT) loci, so no eval-side shortcut can be both orthology-free and representative. The representative re-pretrain -- excluding draft E. coli so that ALL MG1655 windows are orthology-free without any gene filtering -- is the only route to an informative measurement.
